seerr.tab.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Top bar tab label; Seerr is the server's product name, not translated

seerr.section.requests.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Header section pill: the list of requests made of the server

seerr.section.discover.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Header section pill: titles the server suggests requesting

seerr.requests.all.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Header read-out: the list holds every user's requests

seerr.requests.own.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Header read-out: the server shows this user only their own requests

seerr.requests.empty.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Read-out when the server holds no request

seerr.discover.available.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Header control label, followed by its value: whether titles already on the server are listed

seerr.discover.hidden.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Header control value: titles already on the server are left out

seerr.discover.shown.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Header control value: titles already on the server are listed too

seerr.discover.empty.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Read-out when every suggestion is already on the server

seerr.row.seasons.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Request row detail: the seasons a show's request asked for; {list} is numbers like 1, 2

seerr.row.requested_by.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Request row detail: who asked; {name} is a user's name on the server

seerr.row.approved_by.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Request row detail: who approved it; {name} is a user's name on the server

seerr.row.declined_by.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Request row detail: who declined it; {name} is a user's name on the server

seerr.row.of.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Request row download line: bytes downloaded of the whole, e.g. 1.2 GB of 4.0 GB

seerr.chip.pending.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Request row status chip: waiting for an administrator's approval

seerr.chip.approved.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Request row status chip: approved, not yet downloading

seerr.chip.declined.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Request row status chip: an administrator declined it

seerr.chip.failed.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Request row status chip: the download service would not take it

seerr.chip.downloading.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Request row status chip: being downloaded now

seerr.chip.processing.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Request row status chip: approved and on its way

seerr.chip.available.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Request row status chip: on the Plex server

seerr.chip.partly.description: The Seerr tab, the household's Seerr request server: Request row status chip: some seasons are on the Plex server
